page1.description: Gain the benefit of extensive industry experience designed to help you become a confident, safety-focused driver and give you the strongest opportunity to pass your driving test on your first attempt. Lessons are tailored for both learner-logbook students and drivers converting an overseas licence, ensuring clear guidance and support at every stage of the journey.

about_instructor.intro: I'm Amit, and I'm here to support you every step of the way as you learn to drive.
description: I have been a qualified driving instructor since March 2024. Originally from India, I have spent most of my career in management roles, including working as a Manager in the United Kingdom from 2009 to 2016. During that time, I built strong customer relationships and received numerous positive reviews and referrals.
I moved to Australia at the end of 2017. In 2021, I began working as a bus driver with a local bus company, followed by a role as a Coach Driver with Transport NSW in 2022.

More recently, I transitioned into my role as a Driving Instructor. Teaching has always been something I enjoy; I am patient, understanding, and genuinely passionate about helping others. I find it rewarding to meet new people and to teach a life skill that learners will use every day.

I have experience teaching both new drivers and international drivers who are adjusting to Australian road rules. My goal is to help every student become a confident and safe driver for life. I start with the fundamentals and ensure all testing requirements are thoroughly covered—and more. Lessons are tailored to your pace and learning style, ensuring your investment supports not only your driving test but your long-term driving skills.

I teach both automatic and manual vehicles, using a Holden Astra LS or your own car if preferred. I also provide my own easy-to-understand learning materials to support your progress. My main focus is to build your confidence and help you develop strong, safe driving habits. I look forward to supporting you on your driving journey.
